text:
Dallas and Columbus meet again five days after the Stars won 3-1 in Dallas, a game our numbers say they deserved 47% of the time. Both teams are 3-2-0 in their last five. The Stars beat Washington 6-5 on Tuesday behind a Jason Robertson hat trick, but they're missing Miro Heiskanen (upper body), Sam Steel and Kyle Capobianco. Going by how the coach has used them, Nils Lundkvist is next in line for Heiskanen's minutes. Columbus routed Colorado 7-2 to end the Avalanche's three-game winning streak.

The numbers see little between them at five on five, where Dallas has taken 52% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) and Columbus 49%. Dallas allows fewer chances against (2.69 expected goals per 60 minutes to 3.38), and its penalty kill is tighter (0.54 expected goals allowed per game to 0.74). Columbus is weaker on the power play (0.57 per game to Dallas's 0.71). Our model has Dallas ahead 3.18 to 2.71 in expected goals tonight.

In net, the projected starters are Casey DeSmith for Dallas, in for Jake Oettinger, and Cam Talbot for Columbus. DeSmith is at -1.4 goals saved above expected over three games this season after +9.7 last year. Talbot is at +4.0 after -13.7 a year ago. Watch Robertson, who gives us a 38% chance of a goal and whose hat trick took 5:20, as Tom Gulitti of NHL.com posted. Kent Johnson has 11 points in his last ten games and a five-game point streak. Mathieu Olivier is one goal from 50 in the NHL.
